name: fmp_company_peers
description:
Peer companies for one stock from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/stock-peers): tickers in the same sector and exchange with similar market cap, for comparisons.
Returns {symbol, peers}: peers is the list of peer tickers (FMP's peersList).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, e.g. AAPL; upper-cased).
Feed the peers to fmp_key_metrics or fmp_stock_quote to compare; for all companies at once use fmp_stock_peers_bulk.
Example: {"symbol": "MSFT"}
